commands.help [command]: Built-in cmd help and command list. help run explains module workflow.
commands.show [modules|challenges|options|roster|: Default modules; teams equals status. Challenges list IDs, proposed points, occupancy, enable state and prerequisites.
commands.use <module>: Select a module; initializes its option defaults. Selecting again resets options.
commands.set <option> <value>: Set current module option; quote multiword values or paths. Use empty quotes to clear an optional string. Types/ranges/enums checked immediately.
commands.run: Validate required options, execute selected module and auto-save successful mutations. Empty/extra arguments rejected. A printed Error leaves state unchanged.
commands.back: Leave module context and clear its options.
commands.eligible <team>: Show eligible missions and occupancy; eligibility excludes already-active/finished teams, availability additionally depends on capacity.
commands.save: Explicit atomic save; all successful mutations already auto-save. Updates one-generation .bak.
commands.reload: Validate and reload disk state. On failure retain current in-memory state and leave disk untouched.
commands.reset RESET: Explicit destructive reset; same as event/reset confirm RESET. Catalog/resources retained, settings reset to random/2041/min_main=min(3, reachable enabled mains).
commands.exit | quit | EOF: Leave console. State already auto-saved. No extra exit write, so .bak survives exit.

roster/add.description: Organizer adds one player (unique case-sensitive ID).

id.description: ASCII ID, 1–40 letters/digits/_/-; first character alphanumeric.

name.description: Printable Unicode name up to 160 characters; quote multiword names.

roster/import.description: Atomically import UTF-8 CSV with exact id,name header; organizer only.

path.description: CSV path; up to 1 MiB and 2000 total players.

teams/create.description: Organizer forms random balanced teams or explicit controlled mapping. Formation is separate from mission assignment mode.

size.description: Random formation maximum team size; ceil(players/size) balanced teams. Ignored for controlled mapping.

seed.description: Random team formation seed; independent of event assignment seed.

formation.description: Random is normal rule; controlled is explicit organizer override, never player self-selection.

mapping.description: Controlled only: T001=P01,P02;T002=P03,P04. All players exactly once. Quote whole value.

confirm.description: REGENERATE required if activity exists; deletes ALL teams' scores, completions, active assignments and queue. Roster/settings retained.

missions/assign.description: Assign common warehouse first, then eligible free branches; random branches differ while occupied at capacity 1. Enqueue if blocked.

team.description: Team ID or all; stable sorted team order.

mission.description: Empty for automatic choice; explicit mission ID only in controlled mode for one team. Cannot bypass prerequisites/capacity.

progress/complete.description: Organizer verifies and records current mission completion, releases capacity and awards proposed default points.

mission.description: Optional guard: must equal team's active mission. Empty uses active mission.

queue/dispatch.description: Retry waiting teams in FIFO order; skip blocked requests. Does not auto-enqueue idle teams.

event/config.description: Change one scheduling setting; existing active allocations remain intact.

value.description: assignment_mode: random|controlled; seed: integer 0..2^63-1 (resets draw); min_main: 1..enabled reachable main mission count (default 3). Changing threshold may be rejected if existing finale activity would become premature.

resources/config.description: Configure capacity or enable state without invalidating active or explicitly queued allocations.

capacity.description: Empty means unchanged; cannot be below active count.

enabled.description: Empty unchanged; intro/finale cannot be disabled; reject disabling active/explicitly queued mission or making finale unreachable.

event/status.description: Show roster/team progression, scores and waiting teams.

event/leaderboard.description: Show descending total points, team ID breaks ties (not speed).

event/reset.description: Erase event activity/roster/settings; retain current catalog/resource defaults. Previous state goes to .bak until next write.
